note: Beside split-partition-implicit-case-twins-in-different-years-bind-to-one-split: the unsafe twin binds no column to the split, which the build reports as an ambiguous named identity. The replaced test asserted the compile-level `split_identity_conversion_pending`, which does not reach the ledger without an [[identity.partition]].
fails_if: `convert_column_partitions` folds co-delivered case twins onto the one declared split, so the split gets states instead of the family staying unresolved

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon (CVID 20) and KON (CVID 21) together in 2020.
